idea-plugin.name: Helix Keymap
idea-plugin.description:
A modal editing plugin for IntelliJ IDEA implementing the Helix selection-first paradigm. Features:
  • Per-editor modal state: Normal, Insert, Select modes with block/line cursor integration.
  • Selection-first motions: w, b, e, ge, x, %, h, j, k, l, gh, gl, gg.
  • Direct selection actions: d (delete), c (change), y (yank), p / P (paste), ;, Alt+;, ,.
  • Full native multi-caret support.
  • Deep IntelliJ IDE ActionManager integration:
    • g menu: gd, gy, gr, gh, gl, ge, gg
    • space menu: space+f (SearchEverywhere), space+b (RecentFiles), space+s (Structure), space+S (Symbols), space+a (Intentions/Quick-fixes), space+d (Diagnostics), space+r (Rename)
    • [d / ]d: Error jumps
    • Alt+o / Alt+i: Structural AST selection expansion and shrinking
    • Alt+n: Multi-caret select next occurrence
    • Ctrl+c: Toggle line comment
    • K: Quick documentation hover
    • =: Reformat code
    • u / U: Native undo / redo
  • Lightweight Helix command bar: :w, :q, :wq, :wa, :qa.
  • Status bar mode indicator showing active mode and pending key chords.

action.description: Select next occurrence of current selection
